notes.content: [h3]\[0.7.10a4] - PLAYTEST[/h3][h3]Added[/h3][p]- Prologue TestRun selection window;[/p][p]- lockpicker challenge (all levels have codegates in them);[/p][p]- all random challenge (all data and system nodes are random);[/p][p]note: use console to launch a challenge (press ` to open console then type run.start_ch01.lockpicker or run.start_ch09.all_random)[/p][h3]Changed[/h3][p]- Chip (core) now loses strength when Cookies node gets transformed;[/p][p]- protected removed from Codegate, Lose X Link added to \[Exhaust]/\[Transform];[/p][p]- Freemium(node) changed: (60 cred, -3 Link) to (50 cred, -2 Link);[/p][p]- Code Optimization+, Call to Action+ and Overclocking+ all changed to base+Multiuse(2);[/p][p]- starting credits increased to 50; [/p][h3]Fixed[/h3][p]- Lighthouse+, Fire Extinguisher+ and Wire Burn+ bugs;[/p][h3]\[0.7.10a3] - PLAYTEST[/h3][h3]Added[/h3][p]- Roman reenabled after rework (reveal after upload);[/p][h3]Changed[/h3][p]- Flash (node) hide/reveal distance reduced to 1/2 from 2/3 (reg/upg);[/p][h3]Fixed[/h3][p]- Paco Upload and bot to top movement;[/p][h3]\[0.7.10a2] - PLAYTEST[/h3][h3]Added[/h3][p]- set of aspects that allow self-click when on exhausted node;[/p][p]- Paco (pachinko/plinko inspired core);[/p][h3]Changed[/h3][p]- Nullifier reworked to only exhaust the activated node;[/p][h3]Removed[/h3][p]- Roman disabled until technical issues resolve;[/p]

notes.title: Update [0.7.10a1]
notes.content: [p]The new content is not tested whatsoever. Expect bugs, and don't get scared by placeholder art.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Added[/h3][p]- Qubit, ICE-block, Paper Wall, Spring (nodes);[/p][p]- FirewallEOT drop and FirewallAdd drop 1 aspects;[/p][p]- Morning Call (remote reach anywhere on the 1st activation);[/p][p]- Dylan (switch Link and Data eot);[/p][p]- Thomas (switch Trace and Firewall after move);[/p][p]- Roman (remote reach all active nodes); [/p][p]- more sounds;[/p][h3]Changed[/h3][p]- Network password(node). Singleton added to the base version, plus version has Singleton removed;[/p][p]- Secret Dossier+ buff: "Collect 7 Data";[/p][p]- Blue While(+) buff: Downtime reduced on both versions;[/p][h3]Fixed[/h3][p]- Secret Dossier had no number proc, upgraded version gave only 5 Data;[/p]
